name: Last Long Run before Death at the TCS 2018 Marathon
description: Ate a gel at 5 and 10, and drank water 2-3 times. Felt OK until legs gave up. That 6:48/mile 16? I don't think so. Frankly, I am not sure how I am supposed to run 26.2 given how I felt at 17.1 :)
